usedFor: Applivery distributes your mobile app builds and HubSpot holds the customer record. A “New Feedback Report” in Applivery can run “Update Contact” in HubSpot, so the person who reported a bug has it on their record.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feedback Report” in Applivery, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A feedback report is the one Applivery event that comes from a person. “Update Contact” changes the contact you find by email, so support and sales see what they reported.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so the reporter needs a matching address in HubSpot. The reverse direction offers “Delete Build”, which permanently deletes a build, and its HubSpot trigger fires on created or updated deals and is polling.
